    AddSupport.ready(Unit unit, PendingCommands pending)
    Waits, beyond both ids resolving, until every element of the model is declared: no element creation, implements or override still pending in it.

    ImplementsTemplate.ready(Unit unit, PendingCommands pending)
    Waits, beyond both models existing, until no pending command still changes the template: its elements, its links and its own implements.

    ImplementsTemplate.runWhenStuck(Unit unit, PendingCommands pending)
    Never: a template that never completes is never copied, so that a model never inherits half a template.

  • Uses of PendingCommands in ca.mcscert.jpipe.operators

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    boolean
    ApplyOperator.ready(Unit unit, PendingCommands pending)
    Waits, beyond its sources existing, until they are complete: an operator composes what its source models are, not what they are so far (#177).
    boolean
    ApplyOperator.runWhenStuck(Unit unit, PendingCommands pending)
    When its sources exist, none failed to be built, and none still waits on its implements: a source held back by a mistake of its own is composed as far as it got, so that the mistake is reported once, where it is, rather than as a result that is never built (#177).
